candidates.claim: The EDGE_IN ACL bound inbound on the OUTSIDE interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0 permits any source tcp/102 to 10.10.10.0/24 at seq 85, and no earlier entry matches Internet sources to that destination, so Internet hosts can open TCP/102 connections directly into the OT network.
candidates.remediation: Remove the rtr-01 EDGE_IN seq 85 permit for tcp/102 to 10.10.10.0/24 so that OUTSIDE cannot reach the OT side.

candidates.claim: Traffic from OUTSIDE to the OT side on tcp/102 is permitted by the EDGE_IN entry at rtr-01:73, which is not one of the approved cross-zone services, so this traffic bypasses DMZ mediation.
candidates.remediation: Deny tcp/102 from OUTSIDE to 10.10.10.0/24 on rtr-01 EDGE_IN and route any approved OT access through the DMZ services listed in the registry.

candidates.claim: The current rtr-01 configuration contains an added extended permit entry in ip access-list EDGE_IN (tcp to 10.10.10.0/24 port 102) that is absent from the approved baseline.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the rtr-01 EDGE_IN permit entry at line 73 with the approved baseline and remove it unless an approved change record justifies it.
